The **Shape Ops** group of the node palette has 10 nodes: all run.

| Node | Status | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [Flatten](../shape-ops/flatten.md) | Runs | Collapse each sample to one feature dimension. |
| [Permute](../shape-ops/permute.md) | Runs | Reorder every sample dimension. |
| [Reshape](../shape-ops/reshape.md) | Runs | Reshape each sample without changing its element count. |
| [Split](../shape-ops/split.md) | Runs | Split a tensor in two along a sample dimension. |
| [Squeeze](../shape-ops/squeeze.md) | Runs | Remove singleton sample dimensions. |
| [Tensor Broadcast To](../shape-ops/tensor-broadcast-to.md) | Runs | Broadcast tensor to a target shape. |
| [Tensor Expand](../shape-ops/tensor-expand.md) | Runs | Materialize tensor expanded to a target shape. |
| [Tensor Index Select](../shape-ops/tensor-index-select.md) | Runs | Select entries along one dimension by index list. |
| [Unsqueeze](../shape-ops/unsqueeze.md) | Runs | Insert a singleton sample dimension. |
| [View](../shape-ops/view.md) | Runs | View each sample with a different shape. |
